description: This file contains functions, classes, and types related to creating, navigating, and managing flowcharts within an Excalidraw-based application. It includes logic for node placement, link direction, and flowchart navigation.

classes.name: FlowChartNavigator
classes.description: Class for navigating through flowchart nodes based on link directions, supporting exploration and looping through nodes at the same level.

classes.name: FlowChartCreator
classes.description: Class for creating and managing flowchart nodes and their connections, including handling pending nodes and scene integration.

methods.name: getLinkDirectionFromKey
methods.description: Returns the link direction ('up', 'down', 'left', 'right') based on arrow key input.

methods.name: getPredecessors
methods.description: Retrieves predecessor nodes linked to a given node in a specified direction.

methods.name: getSuccessors
methods.description: Retrieves successor nodes linked to a given node in a specified direction.

methods.name: addNewNode
methods.description: Creates a new flowchart node and binding arrow in a specified direction from a start node.

methods.name: addNewNodes
methods.description: Creates multiple new flowchart nodes in a specified direction, distributing them evenly.

methods.name: createBindingArrow
methods.description: Creates and binds a new arrow element between two flowchart nodes based on direction.
